name: Rock cliff section
description: A straight 1.5 m section of mossy grey cliff about 3.5 m high and 1.5 m deep: a rock face on -y that leans back as it rises, broken into ledges and small overhangs by layered strata and split by dark vertical cracks, with moss on the ledges, damp at the foot, a grassy top and ivy hanging over the edge. Sections set side by side join into one continuous cliff.
